_comment: Settings only for the overnight labelling job; passed in with --settings from label-auto.sh
Kept in a separate file for two reasons:
1. .claude/settings.local.json is rewritten by the system every time the user approves a command,
and one such rewrite once wiped out the whole deny block; this file is never touched
2. These restrictions should apply only to automatic runs, not to normal work
allow is a bare Write because CLI 2.1.179 does not match Write(<path>) rules,
so the path boundary is enforced by a hook instead (see guard-queue-write.py)
